A family goes into a plantation home and freely fondles all the furniture and decorations (a display like this would have PROBABLY been roped off even then). Heck, even when the plantation period has ended, there still seems to be some sugarcoating going on.

Toni Morrison has characterized race relations in the US as depending on something she calls the "escape from knowledge."
